notes: Curated overlay for a mechanically diverse sample. Data Dragon derivatives (stats, gold, maps, recipes) are not repeated here; see lol-knowledge/objects/README.md. Numeric mechanics absent from Data Dragon carry declared sources and secondary confidence. Catalog version 3 (2026-11-15): moved to snapshot 16.22.1; stats, gold, descriptions and recipes of the 15 objects are identical to 16.20.1 in Data Dragon; the secondary evidence was not re-checked against the 16.21 and 16.22 patch notes. Catalog version 6 (2026-11-15): damage components may declare applies_life_steal with its own source; Mist's Edge declares it from the LoL Wiki (secondary). Catalog version 7 (2026-11-16): adds 3111 (Mercury's Treads) for its tenacity, declared from the 16.22.1 description. Catalog version 8 (2026-11-16): description stats of every Summoner's Rift item, curated ones included, come from catalog-stats.json (generated); this file keeps effects and reviews. Catalog version 9 (2026-11-16): adds 3032 (Yun Tal Wildarrows). Effects may declare scenario max_stacks (the stat sheet applies them at full stacks) and objects may confirm a generated 0 as a real zero (confirmed_zero_stats). Catalog version 10 (2026-11-16): adds the on-hit damage of 1043, 3091, 3115, 3124 and 3302, with client values (evidence derived) where Data Dragon omits them; stat effects that are always active (Rabadon) are applied by the stat sheet. Catalog version 11 (2026-11-16): adds Spellblade (trigger spellblade) to Sheen, Trinity Force, Lich Bane, Essence Reaver, Iceborn Gauntlet, Dusk and Dawn and Bloodsong, the repeat_on_hit component and patch notes as a source kind (Terminus is now corroborated by the 26.15 notes). Catalog version 12 (2026-11-16): attack counters (stacks.required on on-hit effects), the energized trigger and trigger_energized component, by_level formulas for client level breakpoints and the target_is_structure condition; adds Kraken Slayer, Rapid Firecannon, Statikk Shiv, Voltaic Cyclosword and Hullbreaker, applies Guinsoo's phantom hits and Terminus's light-hit resistances. Catalog version 13 (2026-11-16): the target's missing health in formulas (scope missing_fraction), target_health_below in rotations, damage_types on damage modifiers and the execute component; Kraken Slayer's missing-health increase, Shadowflame and The Collector.

Persistence of stacks across different targets is not published; the model records it as unverified, not as a per-target fact.

effects.name: Espinas
effects.quote: Al recibir un ataque, inflige daño mágico al atacante y aplica un 40% de heridas durante 3 s si se trata de un campeón.

sources.quote: Thorns base damage increased to 20 from 15.
Thorns bonus armor ratio reduced to 10% bonus armor from 15%.
BaseDamage = 20; BonusArmorDamageRatio = 0.1; GrievousAmount = 0.4; GrievousDuration = 3
sources.note: Valores por defecto; la Grieta del Invocador no tiene sobrescritura por modo.

effects.note: The reflected damage is 20 + 10% of the holder's bonus armor as magic damage to the attacker. It is reactive damage mitigated by the attacker's magic resist; it is not a projectile and is not blocked by spell shield. It triggers even when the attack's damage is fully mitigated, but not when the attack is dodged, blocked or misses. Grievous Wounds (40%, 3 s) applies only when the attacker is a champion.
